# NCAI Strategy Partners

> NCAI Strategy Partners (NCAISP) helps businesses identify where AI creates value, then builds, deploys and operates the systems: AI strategy, process automation, custom AI agents, agentic systems, LLM applications, private/sovereign AI and managed AI services. Registered business name: NC Strategy Ops. Target markets: Ireland, the United Kingdom, the United States and Canada.

Key facts:
- Founder & CEO: Nishant Chaudhary (https://ncaistrategypartners.com/about/#founder, https://www.linkedin.com/in/chaudharynishantchetan)
- Contact: hello@ncaistrategypartners.com
- Book an AI Strategy Session: https://ncaistrategypartners.com/#booking
- Pricing is scoped to the process, integrations, data and support required. NCAISP does not publish fixed prices or promise guaranteed results.
- The use cases on this site are illustrative, not completed client projects.

## Capabilities
- [AI Workflows & Agentic Systems](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/agentic-systems/): Coordinate agents, applications, data and human decisions in multi-step business workflows. Start with one process and expand into a connected operating layer.
- [Custom AI Agents](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/ai-agents/): Specialised AI agents that retrieve information, use tools and take permitted actions within a defined scope, with a clear route back to your team.
- [LLM & Custom AI Applications](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/ai-applications/): Purpose-built AI applications using the right language models for your data, quality, latency and cost needs, with RAG and repeatable quality checks.
- [AI Strategy & Opportunity Discovery](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/ai-strategy/): Find where AI creates real business value. We assess your processes, data and systems, then prioritise a practical AI roadmap and first use case.
- [Intelligent Process Automation](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/automation/): Connect the steps that slow your business down. We design automation across applications, teams and decisions, with exceptions and approvals built in.
- [Managed AI Services](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/managed-ai/): Operate and improve your AI systems after launch: monitoring, evaluations, maintenance and optimisation, with service levels agreed for each engagement.
- [Sovereign / Private AI Systems](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/capabilities/sovereign-ai/): Private and sovereign AI designed around your data, model, permission and infrastructure requirements, verified against the actual architecture.

## Solutions
- [AI Revenue Capture](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/ai-revenue-capture/): Turn website visitors into conversations, qualified leads, callbacks and booked appointments.
- [Customer Service Automation](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/customer-service/): Connect approved knowledge, service requests and human escalation.
- [Document Intelligence](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/document-intelligence/): Turn business documents into structured information and reviewable actions.
- [Knowledge Systems](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/knowledge-systems/): Make approved business knowledge accessible in the context of work.
- [Operations Automation](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/operations-automation/): Keep work moving across teams, applications and approval points.
- [Private AI](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/private-ai/): Choose deployment and knowledge boundaries around your organisation.
- [Sales Automation](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/sales-automation/): Reduce the administration between a new enquiry and the next useful action.
- [Voice AI](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/voice-ai/): Design useful voice interactions with clear boundaries and human handover.
- [Workflow Automation](https://ncaistrategypartners.com/solutions/workflow-automation/): Connect repeatable processes across the tools your teams already use.
